name: spawning-pool
title: Spawning Pool
owns: The Spawning Pool: the Hive-owned worktrees, their leases, and the acquire, observe and release receipts that bind a physical worktree to one home, workspace, project, clone, task generation and branch. It holds working copies and never work items.

commands.name: hive-spawning-pool
commands.purpose: Leases on isolated worktrees in the Hive-owned namespace.

receipt_kinds.asserts: A worktree was leased to one task generation, with its physical worktree, base and branch.
The state of one lease and its worktree was read at the stated time.
A lease was ended and its worktree returned, after the preservation checks passed.

test_scope: Isolation, concurrency, interrupted operations and preservation.
